items.computation: The invoice date (Rechnungsdatum) is 03.08.2026 (Monday). The payment period runs 'ab Rechnungsdatum' (from the invoice date), so per § 187(1) BGB the day of the event itself (03.08.) is not counted; counting starts on 04.08.2026. A 14-day period (§ 188(1) BGB) beginning 04.08.2026 ends on 17.08.2026 (04.08. + 13 days = 17.08.). 17.08.2026 is a Monday, not a Saturday, Sunday, or public holiday in NRW, so no shift under § 193 BGB is needed. Final due date: 17.08.2026.
